name: Warehouse utilization
prompt: Warehouse capacity and utilization: utilization rate by warehouse, units stored versus capacity, and which warehouses are closest to full.

binding.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(utilization_pct), 1) AS avg_utilization_pct FROM warehouse_utilization

copy.title: Average utilization
copy.caption: Average warehouse utilization is 22.6%, indicating most capacity remains unused.

binding.sql:
SELECT SUM(units_stored) AS total_units_stored
FROM warehouse_utilization

copy.title: Total units stored
copy.caption: Warehouses currently store 44,428 units in total.

binding.sql: SELECT SUM(capacity_units) AS total_capacity_units FROM warehouse_utilization

copy.title: Total warehouse capacity
copy.caption: All warehouses combined provide 209,000 capacity units.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  warehouse AS warehouse,
  utilization_pct AS utilization_pct
FROM warehouse_utilization
ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC, warehouse

copy.title: Utilization by warehouse
copy.caption: GDL-1 is most utilized at 34.9%, while every warehouse stays below 35% of capacity.

binding.sql:
SELECT region AS region, SUM(units_stored) AS units_stored
FROM warehouse_utilization
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY units_stored DESC

copy.title: Stored units by region
copy.caption: Latin America holds the most stock (~9.8k units) and runs hottest at 34.9% utilization; Europe carries the least load at 15.4%.

binding.sql: SELECT warehouse AS warehouse, city AS city, region AS region, units_stored AS units_stored, capacity_units AS capacity_units, utilization_pct AS utilization_pct FROM warehouse_utilization ORDER BY utilization_pct DESC, warehouse LIMIT 50

copy.title: Warehouses by utilization
copy.caption: GDL-1 is most utilized at 34.9%; all other warehouses are below 23%.
